research_contract.question: How should agents present important work so people can understand it, make necessary decisions and remain in control?
source_scopes: Existing public project pages and decision contracts
Owner-approved observations of readers using an important output
research_contract.decision_to_change: Choose the amount, form and destination of an important output using actual decision value and attention cost.
success_criteria: A reader can find the outcome, supporting evidence, uncertainty and decision they actually need to make.
Reuse the appropriate existing surface and measure attention saved against maintenance and notification cost.
falsifiers: An output creates more navigation or notifications without improving understanding or decision quality.
A polished page obscures the needed action, source evidence or unresolved uncertainty.
evidence_gaps: Publishing more pages or sending fewer messages alone does not prove a better human interface.
watch_triggers: New owner-approved outcome or counterexample changes the decision evidence.
The relevant source, operating constraint or acceptance boundary materially changes.
research_contract.answer_shape: A verified improvement to an existing decision surface with reader observations, limits and a reusable presentation lesson.
research_contract.refresh_policy: Review when relevant owner evidence or decision conditions change; registration starts no collector, benchmark, scheduler or new execution lane.
research_contract.state_note: Library-authored proposed criteria and counterevidence, not an evaluated method or accepted answer. This metadata does not establish measured gains, commercial commitments or authorization for new execution.
